title: Asterism Arcanum | Addon for Iron's Spells and Spellbooks
description: Asterism Arcanum is an addon introducing the Astral School of magic to Iron's Spells and Spellbooks.
body:
![A splash title of the addon, with a purple base and cyan stars across each letter.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1fc0be960ac66d5811c039c55a40baa002bbda78.png)
_Version 0.1.0_

_As a reminder, I am still learning, so bugs may be present! If you have any suggestions for something to add or change, please let me know!_

**IMPORTANT INFORMATION FOR UPDATING VERSIONS**

The previous version of this addon will **_NOT_** properly update to this version. If you are intending to update your world, please **_MAKE A BACKUP_**, and keep in mind that you will need to manually replace items (including scrolls). The reason why this is is the case is listed in the **_FAQ_** below. I have also created a guide (below) to suggest potential item replacements if you do plan to update from the older version of this addon.

Future updates will not have an issue with discontinuity

**What is Asterism Arcanum?**


Asterism Arcanum is an addon for Iron's Spells n' Spellbooks, which introduces a new school of magic, a new structure, new blocks, and 3 new mobs. The new school of magic is the Astral School, which is focused on caster longevity by means of evading damage and maintaining distance from your enemies. In simpler terms, this school is designed for people who like to run away!

The new structure that comes with this addon is called the Astral Observatory, which generates on mountains and is the home of the Astromancer mage npc. Unfortunately, as the observatory has been partially abandoned, hostile mobs have made nests in the structure and consequentially will now attack any interlopers.

These new hostile mobs are Dragonflies, which when killed drop their wings. These wings can be used to craft astral spells, or to craft two new block sets-- the Lumine and Umbral Lumine blocks. These blocks can also be found in the Astral Observatory.

Finally, the mod also introduces the Lunar Moth, which is a neutral creature that can rarely spawn on steep mountain tops. If you struggle to find one of these friendly critters, you may also opt to gather their eggs, which sniffers dig out of the ground! These eggs can be thrown to create new moths, or to deal effects to enemies. There is also the option to summon your own Lunar Moth as a mount using one of the spells in the Astral School.

**New Content:**

**Spells**
- Astral Echo - _Teleport Spell which can be reversed if the ball of light is counterspelled in time._
- Brightburst - _A spell which launches away and damages mobs that are close to you._
- Celestial Tether - _This spell locks you in place (even mid-air!) And nullifies incoming damage until it breaks or you end the spell._
- Star Swarm - _A spell which launches barrages of projectiles towards where the caster aims._
- Summon Lunar Moth - _This spell summons a large Lunar Moth, which can be ridden and will attempt to protect the caster._
- Starfire - _This spell lobs a small ball of light towards where the caster aims, piercing and richocheting through enemies._
- Starcutter - _A spell that creates a ball of light that very quickly explodes, dealing damage._
- Luminous Beam - _This spell creates a long skinny beam of light which damages all enemies it hits._
- Piercing Light - _A spell that creates dozens of small projectiles around the caster, which may hit nearby mobs._
- Silvery Barbs - _This spell can be used to protect pets, summons, and allies that are about to take damage._
- Astral Gateway - _This spell is not meant to be craftable, I am working on a patch for some things players have noticed, meaning very soon I will release an update removing this spell's ability to be crafted._

**Mobs**
- _Lunar Moth_
- _Dragonfly_
- _Astromancer_

**Structure**
- _Astral Observatory_

**Items**
- _Lumine and Umbral Lumine blocks_
- _Dragonfly Wings_
- _Mothspawn_
- _Astrolabe Spellbook_
- _Celestial Staff_
- _Astral Armor_
- _Dragonfly Comb_

**Creative Only**
- _Astral Sea (dimension)_
- _Astral Gateway (spell)_
- _Stellar Talisman (item)_


**FAQ:**

"Why can't we update directly between this version and the previous one?"

_Over the past few months, I have been putting in a lot of work to make the addon much more functional and visually appealing. Unfortunately, this also means that most of the code from the previous version no longer exists in the new version, so Minecraft doesn't know what to do!_

"I love 1.20.1!! Port this to 1.20.1!!"

_If you know someone who is willing to do the work, they can reach out to me for permission. I will not be doing this myself because I am one person and I am providing this content as a courtesy (meaning I get to choose how much effort I put in :D) I will not respond to any comments about this unless they are from people interested in doing the porting themselves._

"Why are there more dependencies now?"

_I have included Aces Spell Utils because it is required for how the Astromancer is configured, as well as some astral spells and items. Azurelib is required to render the celestial staff correctly. ExpandAbility is not used for content accessible in Survival, but in the next update, I will finish the content currently locked to creative mode. I have chosen to include the unfinished content for those who want to play around with it in creative mode!_

"I don't know how to craft these things!"

_The recipes are unlockable in the recipebook, and I would suggest using JEI if you do not have it installed. Dragonfly Wings are the new resource for crafting astral spells and astral runes._

"There's no spellbook?"

_The Astrolabe item functions as a spellbook._

"Where did the old items (scrolls, armor, etc.) go?"

_They have been removed, I will gradually be introducing similar content over the next few updates. See the replacement guide if you want to see what I have changed into new content._

**Replacement/Update Guide:**

**Spells:**
- _Starfire (old) -> Starfire (new) (The spell may or may not stay functional when updating)_
- _Dark Flow -> Brightburst_
- _Luminous Ray -> Luminous Beam_
- _Moonbeam -> Astral Echo_
- _Night Vision -> Summon Lunar Moth (There is no direct replacement for Night Vision at the moment)_
- _Star Swarm (old) -> Star Swarm (new) (This is not the same spell, but it is comparatively effective)_
- _Constellation -> Star Cutter (This spell is similar, but is far more balanced)_

**Items:**
- _Liquid Luminance -> Dragonfly Wings_
- _Astral Armor (old) -> Astral Armor (new)_
- _Celestial Tome -> Astrolabe_


**Future Plans:**
 These are what I would like to achieve, not necessarily in chronological order. I may also end up adding things that are not on this list or abandoning ideas that are on this list!

_Astral Sea Dimension - A dimension similar to the Pocket Dimension, but traversible and with new features and mechanics inside. This dimension will be accessed through an item called the Stellar Talisman.
Sheath Curio - I am not sure what this item will do yet, it may provide passive effects like night vision.
More spells - I have lots of ideas, but many will not survive the testing phase, so stay tuned!
A new boss - this is pretty far away, but it will be coming eventually!
Mod Compat - I wanted to publish this version before working on any compat, because I want to be able to have a neat and tidy set of files to work with when I do start working on compat!_
